leaders who are competent in guiding groups in outdoor experiences, designing and facilitating recreational programs and stewarding our natural environment. The curriculum develops life skills in leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and communication within the context of a Christian worldview. Hands-on learning and field experiences give students practical leadership experience. The program prepares students for careers in state and national park agencies, outdoor education, adventure-based outdoor programming, ecotourism and management of outdoor related businesses. 100 Outdoor Adventure Recreation is a program which intersects with and draws from various disciplines.
